description: This file implements the core logic for invoking system commands with security and policy enforcement, including parsing command requests, evaluating policies, handling approvals, and executing commands via local or macOS app host.

methods.name: warnWritableTrustedDirOnce
methods.description: Logs a warning message once for trusted directory issues to avoid repeated warnings.

methods.name: normalizeDeniedReason
methods.description: Converts a reason string into a standardized SystemRunDeniedReason type.

methods.name: sendSystemRunDenied
methods.description: Sends a denial event and result for a system run request with a specific reason and message.

methods.name: sendSystemRunCompleted
methods.description: Sends a completion event with the execution result and payload JSON.

methods.name: parseSystemRunPhase
methods.description: Parses and validates the system run command request, returning a structured phase object or null on failure.

methods.name: evaluateSystemRunPolicyPhase
methods.description: Evaluates security policies and approvals for the parsed command, returning a policy-enforced phase or null.

methods.name: executeSystemRunPhase
methods.description: Executes the command phase, handling approval checks, macOS app host execution, and actual command run.

methods.name: handleSystemRunInvoke
methods.description: Main entry point to handle a system run invocation, coordinating parsing, policy evaluation, and execution.
